and CM.TERMID = T.TERMID       join ASSIGNMENTS A on CM.CLASSMEETINGID = A.CLASSMEETINGID and A.SGID = CM.SGID       left join ASSIGNMENTACTIVITYDETAILS AAD on AAD.ASSIGNMENTID = A.ASSIGNMENTID       join RESULTS R on A.ASSIGNMENTID = R.ASSIGNMENTID      where CM.DAY between @dtStartdate AND @dtEnddate {0}      union all      select R.STUDENTID, SUBJECTNAME, AAD.DUEDATE D, R.[RESULT], NULL REASON,       R.ASSIGNMENTID EXT, A.CLASSMEETINGID, AAD.ACTIVITYID AID, ctx.ID SUBJCLASSID, A.[WEIGHT], SUBJORDER      from ctx       join ASSIGNMENTS A on A.SGID=ctx.ID       join ASSIGNMENTACTIVITYDETAILS AAD on AAD.ASSIGNMENTID = a.ASSIGNMENTID       join RESULTS R on A.ASSIGNMENTID = R.ASSIGNMENTID      where AAD.DUEDATE between @dtStartdate AND @dtEnddate {0}      union all      select A.STUDENTID, SUBJECTNAME, CM.[DAY] D, NULL [RESULT], A.REASON,       0 EXT, A.CLASSMEETINGID, 'manual' AID, ctx.ID SUBJCLASSID, 0 [WEIGHT], SUBJORDER      from ctx       join CLASSMEETINGS CM ON CM.SGID = ctx.ID select SG.ID, SG.NAME, SG.SUBJECTID       from SG_CLASSES SGC        join SUBJECTGROUPS SG on SG.ID=SGC.SGID       where SGC.CLASSID=@classId and sg.ISMODULAR = 'false'        order by sg.NAME @classId

and SG.SUBJECTID=@subjectId select SG.ID, SG.NAME, SG.SUBJECTID      from SG_CLASSES sgc       join CLASSES cls on cls.CLASSID=sgc.CLASSID       join TEACHERSCLASSES TC on TC.CLASSID=cls.CLASSID       join SUBJECTGROUPS SG on SG.ID=SGC.SGID       join SUBJECTGROUPSGRADES SGG on SGG.SGID=sg.ID and sgg.SCHOOLYEARID=cls.SCHOOLYEARID      where TC.TEACHERID = @teacherId and cls.SCHOOLYEARID=@yearId and SGG.GRADE=@grade and CLS.GRADE=@grade {0}      union      select SG.ID, SG.NAME, SG.SUBJECTID      from SUBJECTGROUPSGRADES SGG       join SUBJECTGROUPS SG on SG.ID=SGG.SGID       join SUBJECTGROUPSTEACHERS SGTCHS on SGTCHS.SGID = SG.ID       left join CLASSMEETINGS CM on CM.SGID=SG.ID       join CLASSMEETINGSTEACHERS CMT on CMT.CMID=CM.CLASSMEETINGID       where (SGTCHS.TEACHERID=@teacherId or CMT.TEACHERID=@teacherId)      and SGG.GRADE=@grade and SGG.SCHOOLYEARID=@yearId {0}      order by SG.NAME @teacherId @yearId @grade @subjectId

select SG.ID, SG.NAME, SG.SUBJECTID      from SUBJECTGROUPS SG       join CLASSSUBJECTGROUPS CSG on CSG.ID=SG.ID      where CSG.PCLASSID=@classId      and exists (select 1         from SUBJECTGROUPSTEACHERS SGTCHS         join CLASSMEETINGS CM on CM.SGID = SG.ID        join CLASSMEETINGSTEACHERS CMT on CMT.CMID = CM.CLASSMEETINGID        where SGTCHS.SGID = SG.ID AND (SGTCHS.TEACHERID=@teacherId or CMT.TEACHERID=@teacherId))      order by SG.NAME @classId @teacherId
